# BestPackFactory - B2B Custom Packaging Manufacturer

BestPackFactory is a professional B2B custom packaging manufacturer based in Shenzhen, China. We provide high-quality packaging solutions for global brands with a focus on speed, reliability, and custom engineering.

## Key Offerings
- **Custom Boxes**: Magnetic gift boxes, rigid boxes, corrugated mailers, folding cartons.
- **Flexible Packaging**: Coffee bags, cannabis mylar bags, spout pouches, retort pouches, roll stock film.
- **Pharma & Food Packaging**: GS1 compliant pharma boxes, food-grade bags, takeaway boxes.
- **Stationery & Labels**: PP ring binder folders, custom roll labels, stickers.

## Business Terms
- **MOQ**: 500 PCS for most categories.
- **Service**: OEM & ODM, Free Dieline support, Sampling.
- **Supply Chain**: Factory direct pricing, worldwide shipping from China.
